If you both live abroad , you’ll have to apply through the embassy first to get clearance to enter the country together ( it is illegal to enter as a tourist with the intention to settle, your wife could get deported ). August might be a bit short , even if they have to answer within 3 months. After that you’ll have to apply online from within israel
